scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until pg_isready -U postgres -d binrun; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until pg_isready -U postgres -d binrun; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.dev:local: npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate && next dev
